title: Establishment of a mapped 5G NAS security context during inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for changing from EPS (S1 mode) to 5GS (N1 mode) while maintaining 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, involving establishment of mapped 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: Mapped 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context derived from EPS security context during inter-system change, containing derived 5G NAS keys and security algorithms.

entities.name: S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
entities.description: Information element containing NAS algorithms, NCC, ngKSI, and message authentication code for inter-system change security context establishment.

entities.name: Mapped K'AMF key
entities.description: 5G security key derived from KASME during inter-system change, used to derive 5G NAS encryption and integrity keys.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key set identifier for 5G security context, with type field indicating mapped security context and value derived from eKSI.

entities.name: 5G-IA0 algorithm
entities.description: Null integrity protection algorithm used for emergency bearer services when no EPS security context exists.

entities.name: 5G-EA0 algorithm
entities.description: Null encryption algorithm used for emergency bearer services when no EPS security context exists.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: NAS connection management state where the UE has an established signaling connection with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: NAS connection management state where the UE does not have an established signaling connection with the network.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
entities.description: NAS message used to activate security context on an access when different security contexts are used on 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services with no EPS security context
entities.description: Condition where UE has PDN connection for emergency services but no current EPS security context, requiring use of null security algorithms.

entities.name: NAS MAC verification
entities.description: Verification process where UE checks the message authentication code in the transparent container, discarding content if verification fails.

relations.description: Inter-system change procedure establishes a mapped 5G NAS security context from EPS security context.
S1 to N1 transparent container IE contains selected 5G NAS security algorithms including 5G-IA0.
S1 to N1 transparent container IE contains selected 5G NAS security algorithms including 5G-EA0.
S1 to N1 transparent container IE contains the ngKSI value for the mapped security context.
Emergency services with no EPS context condition requires use of 5G-IA0 algorithm.
Emergency services with no EPS context condition requires use of 5G-EA0 algorithm.
NAS MAC verification condition determines whether the transparent container content is accepted or discarded.
Inter-system change procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message activates the mapped 5G NAS security context on the target access.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message includes ngKSI to identify the security context to be activated.
